title: Off-Road Performance Target Development
source: STLA Technical Deliverables Rev 0, C; Team Dashboard 2026-10-30
purpose: Set quantitative, traceable off-road targets before architecture selection.
done: Benchmark at least three production vehicles against the required attributes

scorecard.note: Paraphrased summary of the organizer scorecard. The official scorecard in EcoCAR Box is the source of truth.

sections.name: Off-road performance target report
items: Benchmark at least three production vehicles with the off-road capability we want

Every benchmark attribute covered: suspension architecture and travel, tires and wheels, ground clearance, approach, breakover and departure angles, wheelbase, turning radius, driveline, crawl ratio or tractive effort, underbody protection, recovery points, other features (3 per missing one)
Objective, comparable engineering data, and a synthesis of the results
Customer, operating environments, use cases, design priorities and tradeoffs (5 per missing topic; 4 if the most important attributes aren't named)
Preliminary targets for clearance, the three angles, crawl/gear ratios, tire size, turning radius, mass, tractive capability, suspension travel (4 per missing one)
Targets are quantitative and measurable, with units
At least one extra team-chosen metric
Short reasoning for why each target was chosen
How targets affect propulsion, EDU integration, battery packaging, suspension, steering, packaging and feasibility (3 per missing one)
Targets connected to future design decisions and their implications

sections.name: Benchmarking summary spreadsheet
items: Benchmark vehicles named, at least three
Published or measured metrics for every required attribute (5 per missing one)
Our targets shown side by side with the benchmarks
Sources listed for the benchmark data
